scripts.build: vp run --filter './packages/**' --filter '!./packages/md' build && vp run --filter ./packages/md build
scripts.deploy:docs: vp run build:core && node packages/void/dist/cli/cli.mjs deploy
scripts.install:void-dev: vp run build:core && node scripts/void-dev-link.mjs install
scripts.test:metaframeworks: vp test run --project parallel-integration analog.test.ts astro.test.ts nitro-worker.test.ts nuxt.test.ts react-router.test.ts sveltekit.test.ts tanstack-start.test.ts vinext-app.test.ts vinext-pages.test.ts
scripts.test:pages:react-vue: vp test run --project parallel-integration packages/react packages/vue
scripts.test:pages:svelte-solid: vp test run --project parallel-integration packages/svelte packages/solid
scripts.test:unit: vp test run --project unit --project unit-pglite --project cli-unit
